import hashlib,json,os,platform,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/alex/workspace/rupurt/rey-sql-boolean-predicates')
control=Path('/var/tmp/transit-boolean-e82-control-7licugjo/src')
cpu=min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
out=root/'.cache/verification/sql-boolean-main-e82-compile.json'
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
git=lambda path,*args:subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(path),*args],text=True).strip()
assert digest(root/'tests/sql_bench.zig')==digest(control/'tests/sql_bench.zig')
report=dict(scope='pure-compiler-and-paged-aggregate',completed=False,status='running',source={name:dict(revision=git(path,'rev-parse','HEAD'),dirty=bool(git(path,'status','--porcelain')),binary_sha256=digest(path/'zig-out/bin/transit-sql-benchmark')) for name,path in [('control',control),('candidate',root)]},driver_sha256=digest(root/'tests/sql_bench.zig'),lock_sha256=digest(root/'flake.lock'),platform=platform.platform(),cpu=cpu,host_load=os.getloadavg(),build='safe',repetitions=7,samples=[],summary=[])
def save():out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
save()
try:
 for rep in range(8):
  for name,path in ([('control',control),('candidate',root)] if rep%2 else [('candidate',root),('control',control)]):
   p=subprocess.run([str(path/'zig-out/bin/transit-sql-benchmark')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,preexec_fn=lambda:os.sched_setaffinity(0,{cpu}))
   records=[json.loads(line) for line in p.stdout.splitlines()]
   report['samples'].append(dict(engine=name,repetition=rep,warmup=rep==0,exit_code=p.returncode,records=records,stderr=p.stderr));save()
   assert p.returncode==0 and len(records)==13,(name,rep,p.returncode,len(records))
 for index in range(13):
  pair={}
  for name in ('control','candidate'):
   records=[s['records'][index] for s in report['samples'] if s['engine']==name and not s['warmup']]
   signatures=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='elapsed_ns'} for r in records]
   assert all(s==signatures[0] for s in signatures)
   pair[name]=dict(signature=signatures[0],raw_ns=[r['elapsed_ns'] for r in records],median_ns=statistics.median(r['elapsed_ns'] for r in records))
  assert pair['control']['signature']==pair['candidate']['signature']
  report['summary'].append(dict(**pair,candidate_control_ratio=pair['candidate']['median_ns']/pair['control']['median_ns']))
 report.update(completed=True,status='passed')
except BaseException as err:
 report.update(status='failed',error=repr(err));raise
finally:save()
for r in report['summary']:print(r['candidate']['signature'],round(r['candidate_control_ratio'],4))
